title: AUTH accepted on port 25 after EHLO on plain connection via non-TLS path
description: session.rs: run_session is called with is_tls=false for port-25 and port-587 plain connections. The AUTH check at line ~313 gates on is_tls, but a client that sends AUTH on port 587 (submission port, expected to be TLS-upgraded) gets a 534 rather than a silent ignore. More critically: there is no enforcement that port 587 must require TLS before accepting MAIL FROM — the auth guard at line ~414 only fires when credential_store is non-empty. If credential_store is empty (no users configured), port 587 is an open relay accepting MAIL FROM from anyone on a cleartext connection. The intended security model is that port 587 requires AUTH, but there is no mechanism to enforce this: empty credential store = open relay on both ports 25 and 587.
